title: Stagewise Anomaly Detection for E-Transaxle Quality Monitoring Using Wavelet and STFT Features
abstract: arXiv:2609.22172v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This paper presents two interpretable machine-learning frameworks for quality screening of e-transaxle assemblies in electric vehicles: a Stagewise Wavelet Isolation Forest (SWIF) framework and a short-time Fourier transform (STFT)-based diagnostic framework. High-dimensional vibration signals acquired from front and back accelerometers are analyzed across multiple operating stages to capture stage-dependent vibration behavior. In the SWIF framework, signals are decomposed using a five-level Daubechies-4 discrete wavelet transform, and blockwise mean-squared coefficients are extracted from the selected wavelet detail level to obtain compact multiscale features. In the STFT-based framework, dominant-frequency trends are extracted from time-frequency representations and summarized through regression coefficients with respect to instantaneous motor speed. translated_abstract: 本文提出了两种用于电动汽车电驱动桥总成质量筛查的可解释机器学习框架：分阶段小波孤立森林框架和基于短时傅里叶变换（STFT）的诊断框架。通过分析从前、后加速度传感器采集的高维振动信号在多个运行阶段的数据，以捕捉与阶段相关的振动行为。在SWIF框架中，信号采用五层Daubechies-4离散小波变换进行分解，并从选定的小波细节层提取分块均方系数，从而获得紧凑的多尺度特征。在基于STFT的框架中，从时频表示中提取主频趋势，并通过相对于瞬时电机转速的回归系数加以概括。异常检测模型仅使用合格的生产单元进行训练，在假设……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出两种可解释的机器学习框架（分阶段小波孤立森林SWIF与基于STFT的诊断框架），利用多运行阶段振动信号的小波多尺度特征和主频-转速回归特征，仅用合格产品训练即可实现电动汽车电驱动桥总成的异常检测与质量筛查。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes two interpretable machine-learning frameworks—a Stagewise Wavelet Isolation Forest (SWIF) and an STFT-based diagnostic framework—that leverage multiscale wavelet features and dominant-frequency-versus-speed regression features from multistage vibration signals to enable anomaly detection and quality screening of e-transaxle assemblies using only accepted production units for training.
